items.name: elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter
items.description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
items.comment: 安全垂类技能包登顶：82 个技能 + 15 个斜杠命令，把 681 个已披露漏洞报告模式浓缩成 24 大漏洞类别的可复用攻击/排查矩阵。连续第二日上榜即冲至榜首，「AI 红队」叙事持续放量。

items.name: mvanhorn/last30days-skill
items.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
items.comment: 任意话题在 Reddit/X/YouTube/HN/Polymarket 五源近 30 天讨论的聚合检索与有据综述生成器，6.8 万星的话题研究垂类头部。连续第二日上榜。

items.name: alibaba/open-code-review
items.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
items.comment: 阿里规模实战验证的混合架构审查工具：确定性规则管线 + LLM Agent 双轨，行级精准评论，内置多语言安全规则集。三日内二度上榜，「AI 审代码」主题工程完成度最高的一席。

items.name: Tencent/LoopForge
items.description: Self-hosted workflows for coding-agent delivery. Orchestrate CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code with scripts and human approval gates. Includes Local workflows for coding assistants.
items.comment: 腾讯官方编码代理交付工作流：自托管编排 CodeBuddy/Codex/Claude Code，脚本化流水线 + 人工审批门禁。昨日掉榜今日回归，企业侧 Agent 治理需求信号明确。

items.name: dream-num/univer
items.description: Build your own AI office with Univer Office SDK. Bring editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing into your product for people and AI agents. Built on an extensible open-source core.
items.comment: 今日增量王 +1,776 却只排第 5。开源 Office SDK 把编辑/计算/协作/文件处理打包成可嵌入组件，面向人类与 AI Agent 共用的办公底座。连续第三日上榜且增量持续放大。

items.name: getarcaneapp/arcane
items.description: Modern Docker Management, Designed for Everyone
items.comment: 面向所有人的现代化 Docker 管理面板，界面优先的容器运维方案。连续第二日上榜，今日仍在活跃推送。

items.name: google-labs-code/stitch-skills
items.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.
items.comment: Google Labs 官方技能库，遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准、兼容 Antigravity/Gemini CLI/Claude Code/Cursor。停更 92 天仍凭官方背书惯性上榜，「官方库长尾传播」极端样本。

items.name: cursor/plugins
items.description: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
items.comment: Cursor 官方插件规范仓库首次上榜：AI 编辑器从「内置功能」走向「开放插件平台」的信号，+196 低位上榜说明是事件驱动而非惯性传播。

items.name: obra/superpowers
items.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
items.comment: 总星 31.9 万、全榜总星第一的巨型技能框架：头脑风暴→计划→TDD→验证的 Agent 开发方法论。停更 14 天仍保持近 600 日增，技能包赛道常青头部首次现身。

items.name: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui
items.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
items.comment: Agent-前端交互协议标准，+1,444 日增全榜第二却只列第 10，脱钩极端再现。连续第四日上榜，前端集成 Agent 的协议层正从提案走向共识。

items.name: backnotprop/plannotator
items.description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.
items.comment: 把「监督 Agent」做成工作台：规划、批注、审代码、团队共享，一键把反馈回传给 Agent。连续第四日上榜，「人机协作监督层」从概念落成产品。

items.name: sveltejs/svelte
items.description: web development for the rest of us
items.comment: 常青前端框架，无大事件惯性上榜，今日仍有活跃推送。编译时框架路线的代表选手。

items.name: affaan-m/ECC
items.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
items.comment: 新面孔即总星 30.5 万（全榜第二）：Agent harness 性能优化体系，「技能+本能+记忆+安全+研究先行」五层结构，横跨 Claude Code/Codex/Opencode/Cursor。技能包赛道头部巨型化最新样本。

items.name: jingyaogong/minimind
items.description: 🧠 Train a 64M-parameter LLM from scratch in just 2h!
items.comment: 2 小时从零训练 64M 参数小模型的中文教学标杆，LLM 入门首选之一。停更 21 天惯性回归，今日唯一中文项目席位。

items.name: google-research/paper-orchestra
items.description: PaperOrchestra is a multi-agent framework for automated AI research paper writing.
items.comment: Google Research 多智能体论文自动写作框架，+1,175 高增量却垫底第 15，今日脱钩最极端样本。连续第二日上榜，「AI 科研自动化」持续发酵。
